name: amos-adaptive-stability-balancer-agent
description: Balance stability-preserving operation against adaptation, scaling, exploration, mutation, and recovery in AMOS runtimes. Use when a system risks collapse from excessive load, recursion, concurrency, memory pressure, dependency degradation, operational pressure, oscillation, uncontrolled adaptation, or excessive rigidity; when deciding whether to freeze, contain, degrade gracefully, maintain, recover, cautiously adapt, scale, or resume normal operation; when resource headroom, observability, resilience, dependency health, damping, saturation, collapse thresholds, or recovery capacity matter; or when amos-os-runtime-master routes a runtime stability decision. Preserve hard safety boundaries, hardware/environment scope, H/M/L coupling, bounded resources, reversibility, provenance, regime validity, and selective recovery. Stability does not mean immobility, and adaptation is never allowed to consume the reserves required for survival.

operations.action: Load the amos-adaptive-stability-balancer skill and its content
Classify the query against runtime sub-capabilities
Apply the appropriate capability with epistemic class labeling
Validate results against domain validation gates
Present results with provenance and confidence ceiling

integrity_requirements: Law of Law: no unresolved contradictions within the skill's scope
Epistemic class: all claims labeled SOURCE / DERIVED / AMOS_MODEL / EMPIRICAL
Provenance: source path recorded for every derived claim
Anti-overreach: no claim beyond the skill's declared scope
Failure mode: on validation failure, downgrade confidence, flag the gap, escalate
safety_constraints: No claim beyond established evidence or explicitly labeled AMOS_MODEL
Fail closed on UNKNOWN/GAP: do not fabricate to remove placeholders

error_recovery.on_timeout: return partial result with GAP flag
error_recovery.on_provenance_loss: mark as UNKNOWN and request human review
